## Pull request overview

Fixes dashboards rendering charts/tables with empty datasets by ensuring widget inline data survives `defineStack()` Zod validation and is read correctly at runtime.

**Changes:**
- Update `DashboardRenderer` to fall back to `widget.options.data` when `widget.data` is absent (Zod-stripped).
- Migrate example stacks to place inline widget data under `options.data` (and remove `@ts-ignore` usage).
- Add widget data extraction tests for charts/tables and empty-data fallback.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx | Adds `options.data` fallback for chart and table widget data extraction. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.widgetData.test.tsx | New tests validating widget data extraction from `options.data` (and legacy `widget.data`). |
| examples/todo/objectstack.config.ts | Moves dashboard widget inline data under `options.data`. |
| examples/kitchen-sink/objectstack.config.ts | Moves dashboard widget inline data under `options.data`. |
| examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts | Moves dashboard widget inline data under `options.data`. |
</details>

In the `table` widget mapping, `data` is set to `widgetData?.items || []`. This still drops data when `widget.data`/`options.data` is provided as an array (not `{ items: [...] }`), which is an existing pattern in `packages/components/src/stories-json/dashboard.stories.tsx` (WithGridLayout). Consider mirroring the chart logic here (accept array or `{items}`) so table widgets don’t render empty when inline data is an array.
